title: Feeding our Hungry Ghosts
speaker: Nomon Tim Burnett
summary: The talk invites listeners to acknowledge and accept their own inner struggles, such as feelings of desperation and dissatisfaction, and to cultivate a sense of gratitude and joy instead. By doing so, they can help their own "hungry ghosts" to experience a state of ease and release. This process is not about suppressing or denying their struggles, but rather about embracing them and finding a sense of peace and liberation.
